Use supplied short parent_alias P001 etc as parent_design_id, and diagnosis_alias D001 etc as diagnosis_id. Choose only supplied certified parents. Preserve all original objectives and physical conditions. refine_family preserves shared variables; refine_layers explicitly creates independent layer variables within original family bounds. Expectations are untested, not outcomes. No route or plan-count ceiling. An empty plans list is allowed. Do not fabricate observations, material identities or new bounds.
